title: Multiplicity of negative one of independence polynomials of graphs
summary: We initiate the study of the multiplicity of negative one of independence polynomials of graphs. In this article, we simply refer to this as the \emph{multiplicity} of a graph. As applications, we provide a graph-theoretic description of trees whose independence complexes are contractible, give a new sufficient condition for independence polynomials of graphs to be log-concave, and finally, determine possible pairs $(\operatorname{mult}_{-1}P_G, α(G))$, where $P_G$ denotes the independence polynomial of $G$, and $α(G)$ the independence number.
